identificationModule.briefTitle: Radiation Therapy (RT) and Temozolomide (TMZ) in Treating Patients With Newly Diagnosed Glioblastoma or Gliosarcoma
identificationModule.officialTitle: Phase III Trial Comparing Conventional Adjuvant Temozolomide With Dose-Intensive Temozolomide in Patients With Newly Diagnosed Glioblastoma

armGroups.label: Conventional adjuvant TMZ
armGroups.description: Concurrent radiation therapy with concurrent temozolomide (75 mg/m2) up to 49 doses. Starting four weeks after completion of RT, 100mg/m2 adjuvant temozolomide days 1 to 5 of 28 day cycle.
interventionNames: Drug: 100mg/m2 adjuvant temozolomide days 1 to 5 of 28 day cycle

armGroups.label: Dose-dense adjuvant TMZ
armGroups.description: Concurrent radiation therapy (RT) with concurrent temozolomide (75 mg/m2) up to 49 doses. Starting four weeks after completion of RT, 75mg/m2 adjuvant temozolomide days 1-21 of 28 day cycle.
interventionNames: Drug: 75mg/m2 adjuvant temozolomide days 1-21 of 28 day cycle

armGroups.label: No adjuvant TMZ (not randomized )
armGroups.description: Concurrent radiation therapy (RT) with concurrent temozolomide (75 mg/m2) up to 49 doses. Not randomized to either adjuvant TMZ arm.

interventions.name: Concurrent temozolomide
interventions.description: Daily oral temozolomide (75 mg/m2) up to 49 doses.

interventions.name: 100mg/m2 adjuvant temozolomide days 1 to 5 of 28 day cycle
interventions.description: Oral temozolomide on days 1-5 of a 28-day cycle. Dose starts at 150mg/m2 for first cycle, increases to 200mg/m2 for subsequent cycles if no unacceptable toxicity. Treatment repeats every 28 days for up to 6 courses in the absence of disease progression or unacceptable toxicity. Patients with responding disease may receive up to 6 more courses of temozolomide.

interventions.name: 75mg/m2 adjuvant temozolomide days 1-21 of 28 day cycle
interventions.description: Oral temozolomide on days 1-21 of a 28-day cycle. Dose starts at 75mg/m2 for first cycle, increases to 100mg/m2 for subsequent cycles if no unacceptable toxicity. Treatment repeats every 28 days for up to 6 courses in the absence of disease progression or unacceptable toxicity. Patients with responding disease may receive up to 6 more courses of temozolomide.
